# A reply lists a question's own lead-in as the title

Unedited live replies of the one-family-per-batch run d26-real-1fam-low-24 on
chapter_4_poetry_and_lyrics_quiz_med_facit. The grouping gives q5 body:0018 to body:0020 as its
own chunks and names body:0002 as the title. Reply `docx_w1-05` lists body:0018, "Read the
sentence:", as its `title`, and its converted item lists body:0019 and body:0020.
